objective: Compare agent-memory accuracy under one evaluator-owned, reproducible protocol.

included: answer quality when a fixed reader and judge are pinned

dataset.goldIsolation: Adapters receive only public records, raw native sessions, and public queries. Evaluator labels are read only by validation and scoring code.
dataset.integrity: Every published run records and verifies the SHA-256 digest of every dataset file.

controls.aggregation: median of the three run-level metric values
controls.recordOrder: ascending benchmark timestamp, then stable source ID
controls.queryOrder: ascending issuedAt timestamp, then stable question ID
controls.storeIsolation: fresh system store, project root, HOME, database, bank, or graph group for every system and run

retrievalScoring.strictCorrect: For answerable queries, every required evidence group is represented and no forbidden source is returned. For abstention queries, the system returns an empty abstention.
retrievalScoring.missingPrediction: incorrect for supported and applicable queries
retrievalScoring.unsupportedFeature: N/A with a reason; never zero and never included in a denominator

nativeCaptureScoring.secretRetention: reported separately and never hidden inside a composite

reader.publicationRule: Answer-quality metrics are N/A until an immutable model revision, prompt SHA-256, decoding parameters, and context serializer hash are recorded for every system.

judge.publicationRule: Semantic judging is N/A until an immutable judge revision, rubric SHA-256, and decoding parameters are recorded. Gold labels and system identity must not be exposed to the judge.

vectorBaseline.publicationRule: The semantic vector-only baseline is N/A until its exact embedding model revision and configuration hash are pinned. The deterministic signed-FNV hash-vector implementation is reported only as a hash-vector control.

secondaryQualityScore.eligibility: N/A unless all five components were reproduced under this protocol; missing components are never reweighted.
secondaryQualityScore.rankingRule: Raw metrics and denominators are primary. The secondary score must not replace the separate normalized and native tables.

statistics.interval: paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval with 10000 resamples and seed 20260713
statistics.claimRule: Do not claim a meaningful winner when the paired interval for the difference includes zero.

publicationRequirements: container and database image digests when applicable
all extraction, embedding, reranker, reader, and judge model revisions
operating system, hardware, language runtimes, and material environment variables
one raw record per system, mode, dataset, question, and run
